versions.content: Timing properties of hardware Type: valid Description: The ECU Resource template shall provide means to describe the timing properties for hardware I/O, e.g. the latency introduced by a digital I/O hardware port. Rationale: Hardware I/O can introduce an additional significant latency, which must be taken into account for the analysis and validation of a system's timing behavior. Use Case: Analysis and validation of timing behavior. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
